legacy_vad_hook.cause: hook requested metadata for webrtcvad instead of installed webrtcvad-wheels
legacy_vad_hook.fix: project hook uses installed distribution metadata

native_pronunciation.isolated_reproduction: Piper exited natively when pronunciation data directory contained non-ASCII characters
native_pronunciation.fix: resolve existing Windows ASCII alias before native initialization; reject unavailable aliases before fatal calls

first_probe_after_alias_fix.scope: synthetic-only probe; no microphone, speakers or action dispatch
first_probe_after_alias_fix.investigation: Cold parent-side synthesis can stop telemetry consumption; bounded idle heartbeat queue previously raised queue.Full. Heartbeats now drop under backpressure and have a regression test. Actual failure role was not captured in that probe; subsequent probe records it.

windowed_recognizer.diagnosis: pywhispercpp.utils.redirect_stderr unconditionally calls sys.stderr.flush; a windowed executable has sys.stderr=None
windowed_recognizer.fix: load with a null Python stream and discard native diagnostic logs using whisper_log_set
windowed_recognizer.source_reproduction_after_fix: real small.en recognized a public synthetic phrase while stdout/stderr were None; microphone and speakers remained closed

build_cache.observation: a rebuilt archive still lacked the new native log handler despite current source; archive was inspected before acceptance
build_cache.fix: build with PyInstaller --clean, then inspect bundled recognition code and compare bundled QML with source

test_runner.observation: a temporary stdin-based pytest wrapper cannot be the main module of spawned Windows workers; it was stopped
test_runner.fix: run the project interpreter with -m pytest; keep windowed-stream unit test isolated from the real native log callback
